wiki.title: Laurie Davies (politician)
wiki.extract: Laurie Ann Davies (born February 27, 1962) is an American politician who serves in the California State Assembly. A Republican, she represents the 74th district, including southern Orange County, including Laguna Niguel, Dana Point, San Juan Capistrano, and San Clemente.
